text: {"name":"hci_tx_ready_check","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Polls HCI transmit status bits, selects and updates the active TX buffer descriptor when a buffer completion bit is set, and clears the TX buffer when no further transmission is pending.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"v0":"tx_status_regs","v1":"selected_tx_buffer_ptr","v2":"previous_tx_buffer_ptr"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":44,"meaning":"word holding the active TX buffer descriptor/address"},{"offset":88,"meaning":"byte TX status flags, bits 2 and 3 indicate buffer completion/selection state"},{"offset":16,"meaning":"byte in a TX buffer descriptor marked when the previous buffer is released"}]}
